notes: §1985:XVI.1.4.3 GR3: the segment is in its initial state when 'Control is transferred explicitly to that segment from a segment with a different segment-number', and in its last-used state on an implicit return or an EXIT PROGRAM return. Explicit transfers (GO TO, PERFORM: §1985:IV.4.4.2) land on a pc whose __SegOf differs from __seg, so EmitDispatchMethod's loop calls __EnterSegment (EmitSegmentState); a PERFORM or CALL return restores the caller's __seg in the nested __Dispatch's finally, so nothing resets. The witness GOes TO SECTION 60 from a fixed section twice and sees INITIAL twice; probes at 85: seg1 (PERFORM of SECTION 50 twice: INIT FIX ALT twice; GO TO from SECTION 60 into SECTION 50 twice: J-INIT twice), seg2 (CALL of a contained program from SECTION 55, EXIT PROGRAM, then the altered GO TO: ALT AFTER CALL, last-used), seg4 (same-segment PERFORM keeps the ALTER). c: COBOL0902/COBOL0810 at 2002.
